authorization: Dexter required RM1P6-CP-U09 to retain strict hook, exact path return, active-pointer readback and validation while landing the deterministic observability standard.

recoveryArtifact.reason: This artifact narrowly records the two derived index bytes that were regenerated before the new deterministic writer could issue their first hook receipts.

rootCause: The old project-memory build wrote deterministic index files directly, so a correct regeneration after CP-U09's baseline had no same-package pre/post edge. CP-U09 now makes future changed index writes invoke the bounded deterministic-index pre/post writer; this recovery is only for the already-produced bytes.

entries.reason: The index is a deterministic projection of the current approved inventory and memory bytes; `build --check` proves the final byte, while the new writer forbids a future partial output set.
